# Disagreement Log — GTH_068

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 68
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 68 | "persecuted" | "persecuted" | "hunt you down" | Intensity of persecution verb |
| 2 | 68 | "And no place will be found" | "no place will be found" (no connector) | "for there will be no place found" | Clause connector: "and" vs. none vs. "for" (causal) |
| 3 | 68 | "where you have been persecuted" | "where you were persecuted" | "where you have been persecuted" | Tense: present perfect vs. past |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA preserves "And" (Coptic connector present), "persecuted" throughout, and present perfect "have been persecuted."
